gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed primary glioblastoma by World Health Organization (WHO) 2021 criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase II/III trial tests how well adding mycophenolate mofetil, to the usual treatment with intensity-modulated radiation therapy and temozolomide works for the treatment of glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed primary glioblastoma by World Health Organization (WHO) 2021 criteria
Patient is a candidate for first-line standard of care chemoradiation per treating physician(s)

role_evidence.quote: To compare the overall survival (OS) (phase III) and progression-free survival (PFS) (phase II) between the experimental arm (mycophenolate mofetil \[MMF\] + standard of care \[SOC\]) and the control arm (SOC).

agents.drug_class_hint: immunosuppressant, IMPDH inhibitor (mycophenolate mofetil, ester prodrug of mycophenolic acid)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Mycophenolate mofetil blocks enzyme activity which can disrupt tumor activity and may make the tumor more sensitive to radiation and/or temozolomide.

role_evidence.quote: Testing the Addition of an Anti-Cancer Drug, Mycophenolate Mofetil, to the Usual Treatment (Radiation Therapy and Temozolomide) for Advanced Brain Cancer

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

coder_notes: Arm I is registered as EXPERIMENTAL but is described as the SOC control arm, hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes. Title/condition say 'advanced' but eligibility requires newly diagnosed GBM before first-line chemoradiation, so newly_diagnosed. Active moiety given as mycophenolic acid (mofetil is the ester); formulation_flag left none although MMF is technically a prodrug of MPA. Stratified log-rank tests mentioned but stratification factors not named; no biomarker rows.
